# MCM Helper public Papyrus interfaces

These files are the public compiler interfaces from MCM Helper v1.6.2, commit
`9df6b69348dea57b3247b9f812711384f1113bab`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Exit-9B/MCM-Helper

They are used only to compile Arcane Activation's MCM script. The game uses
the compiled scripts supplied by the installed MCM Helper mod.
